decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks rest on the firm's core thermoforming and dental lab material know-how, so it can interpret lab feedback and refine the line despite reduced website visibility after 2019.
The PETG thermoforming blank sits squarely within established in-house thermoforming competence and R&D, giving strong absorptive capacity to keep improving it at low cost.
Custom earmolds are a core hearing-care competence that benefits from skilled custom manufacturing and digital production, so the firm absorbs market signals well and should continue the line.
Custom hearing protection earmolds reuse the same earmold and digital manufacturing knowledge in an adjacent market the firm understands, so continued learning justifies keeping them.
